name: Side-Lying Triceps Push-Up
steps: Lie on your side with your knees slightly bent and wrap your lower arm around your waist.
Plant the palm of your top hand flat on the floor right in front of your bottom shoulder with fingers pointing forward.
Press forcefully through your top palm to straighten your elbow and lift your upper torso off the floor.
Lower your torso slowly back down until your shoulder lightly touches the floor, and switch sides after completing one arm.
tips: Keep your hips resting on the floor so your top triceps performs the lifting work.
Keep your working elbow pointed behind you as you press.
